summary: Session journal fsyncs only at boundaries: turns, operation start/finish and all other records stay synced; authorization_decided and tool_execution_started/finished ride the next boundary. Append lock waits (blocking flock) instead of failing. journal_fsync_count() exposes the counter.
commands_run: A/B session_fsync with every record synced

cargo test --locked --all-features --test core_session (x3) --test session_recovery --test session_torn_tail --test session_cli --test session_new --test stage1_session_tree --test headless_lifecycle --test session_maintenance_owner --test cli_session --test resume_compact_owner
notes: Deviation: the row asks <= 2 fsyncs per tool call. operation_finished stays synced because the provider operation_finished is the last record of a turn; losing it would make recovery mark a completed turn interrupted. core_session user_shell cancel test now cancels when the child provably started (a fixed 50 ms could expire during pre-spawn journal fsyncs and exercise the pre-spawn path instead); exposed while bisecting after ZE-302.
